memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Front desk booked patient's appointment with Dr Priya Natarajan for 2025-04-05 at 10:30 am for routine follow‑up of vitamin D deficiency.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient attends for review of vitamin D deficiency and general well‑being.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, weight 62 kg, height 158 cm, BMI 24.8 (overweight). No pallor, thyroid normal, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin D deficiency, overweight. Advised on diet and activity.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then 1000 IU daily. Order serum 25‑OH vitamin D, calcium, phosphate. Return if new bone pain, muscle weakness, fever >39°C, or persistent vomiting.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Cholecalciferol 60000 IU oral once weekly for 8 weeks, then cholecalciferol 1000 IU oral daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 14 ng/mL (ref 30‑100). Serum calcium 9.1 mg/dL (ref 8.6‑10.3). Serum phosphate 3.2 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Follow‑up after loading dose of vitamin D; reports mild knee discomfort.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, weight 61.5 kg, BMI 24.6 (overweight). Advised diet and activity.
EXAMINATION: No joint swelling, muscles normal.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin D deficiency improving, overweight. Continue maintenance dose.
ARRANGEMENTS: Change to cholecalciferol 1000 IU oral daily. Repeat serum 25‑OH vitamin D, calcium, phosphate in 3 months. Return if worsening pain, new fractures, fever >39°C, or unexplained weight loss.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 22 ng/mL (ref 30‑100). Serum calcium 9.2 mg/dL (ref 8.6‑10.3). Serum phosphate 3.3 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine review; patient feels better, no bone pain.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/76 mmHg, weight 61 kg, BMI 24.4 (overweight). Advised diet and activity.
EXAMINATION: Lungs clear, abdomen soft.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin D deficiency borderline, overweight. Annual metabolic screen.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU daily. Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, plus serum 25‑OH vitamin D, calcium, phosphate. Offer influenza vaccine today (autumn). Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or melena.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 28 ng/mL (ref 30‑100). Serum calcium 9.3 mg/dL (ref 8.6‑10.3). Serum phosphate 3.4 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5). Fasting LDL 110 mg/dL (ref <100), HDL 48 mg/dL (ref >40), triglycerides 150 mg/dL (ref <150). Fasting blood sugar 92 mg/dL (ref 70‑100).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Review after lipid results; patient reports occasional fatigue.
EXAMINATION: BP 132/82 mmHg, weight 60.8 kg, BMI 24.3 (overweight). Advised diet and activity.
EXAMINATION: No cardiac murmurs, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin D deficiency near target, mild hyperlipidaemia, overweight. Continue vitamin D, consider lifestyle for lipids.
ARRANGEMENTS: Keep cholecalciferol 1000 IU daily. Repeat serum 25‑OH vitamin D, calcium, phosphate in 3 months. Lipid panel repeat in 6 months. Return if new chest pain, dyspnoea, fever >39°C, or jaundice.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 31 ng/mL (ref 30‑100). Serum calcium 9.4 mg/dL (ref 8.6‑10.3). Serum phosphate 3.5 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine follow‑up; patient feels well, no symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, weight 60.5 kg, BMI 24.2 (overweight). Advised diet and activity.
EXAMINATION: Abdomen soft, no organomegaly.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin D sufficient, overweight. No intervention needed.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU daily. Repeat serum 25‑OH vitamin D, calcium, phosphate in 3 months. Return if bone pain, muscle weakness, fever >39°C, or rectal bleeding.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 34 ng/mL (ref 30‑100). Serum calcium 9.5 mg/dL (ref 8.6‑10.3). Serum phosphate 3.6 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Check‑up; patient reports mild thirst, otherwise well.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, weight 60.2 kg, BMI 24.1 (overweight). Advised diet and activity.
EXAMINATION: No edema, lungs clear.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin D adequate, overweight. No new issues.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU daily. Offer influenza vaccine today (autumn season). Return if polyuria, unexplained weight loss, fever >39°C, or vision changes.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Annual review; patient asymptomatic.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/76 mmHg, weight 60 kg, BMI 24.0 (borderline normal). Advised maintain activity.
EXAMINATION: Cardiovascular and respiratory systems normal.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin D sufficient, overweight resolved, stable health.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU daily. Repeat serum 25‑OH vitamin D, calcium, phosphate yearly. Return if new bone pain, fractures, fever >39°C, or persistent diarrhoea.
